"""Intent tests for mdata.align_calendar: one calendar, forward fill, and a gap limit (DATA-03, DATA-04)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

from mdata import GapError, Prices, RawRow
from mdata.calendar import align_calendar


def _rows(data: dict) -> list[RawRow]:
    return [RawRow(date=d, ticker=t, close=c) for d, t, c in data["rows"]]


@pytest.mark.intent
def test_tc02_one_calendar_with_filled_gaps(golden):
    data, expected = golden("mdata", "TC-02")
    prices = align_calendar(_rows(data), max_gap=data["max_gap"])
    assert isinstance(prices, Prices)
    assert prices.dates == tuple(expected["dates"])
    assert prices.tickers == tuple(expected["tickers"])
    assert set(prices.closes) == set(expected["closes"])
    for ticker, closes in expected["closes"].items():
        assert prices.closes[ticker] == tuple(closes), ticker


@pytest.mark.intent
def test_tc02_default_gap_limit_also_fills(golden):
    data, expected = golden("mdata", "TC-02")
    prices = align_calendar(_rows(data))
    assert prices.dates == tuple(expected["dates"])
    assert prices.closes["B"] == tuple(expected["closes"]["B"])


@pytest.mark.intent
def test_tc03_six_date_gap_raises_gap_error_naming_ticker(golden):
    data, expected = golden("mdata", "TC-03")
    assert expected["raises"] == GapError.__name__
    with pytest.raises(GapError, match=expected["match"]):
        align_calendar(_rows(data), max_gap=data["max_gap"])


@pytest.mark.intent
def test_tc03_gap_within_a_larger_limit_is_filled(golden):
    data, _ = golden("mdata", "TC-03")

"""Intent tests for mdata.align_calendar: one calendar, forward fill, and a gap limit (DATA-03, DATA-04)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

from mdata import GapError, Prices, RawRow
from mdata.calendar import align_calendar


def _rows(data: dict) -> list[RawRow]:
    return [RawRow(date=d, ticker=t, close=c) for d, t, c in data["rows"]]


@pytest.mark.intent
def test_tc02_one_calendar_with_filled_gaps(golden):
    data, expected = golden("mdata", "TC-02")
    prices = align_calendar(_rows(data), max_gap=data["max_gap"])
    assert isinstance(prices, Prices)
    assert prices.dates == tuple(expected["dates"])
    assert prices.tickers == tuple(expected["tickers"])
    assert set(prices.closes) == set(expected["closes"])
    for ticker, closes in expected["closes"].items():
        assert prices.closes[ticker] == tuple(closes), ticker


@pytest.mark.intent
def test_tc02_default_gap_limit_also_fills(golden):
    data, expected = golden("mdata", "TC-02")
    prices = align_calendar(_rows(data))
    assert prices.dates == tuple(expected["dates"])
    assert prices.closes["B"] == tuple(expected["closes"]["B"])


@pytest.mark.intent
def test_tc03_six_date_gap_raises_gap_error_naming_ticker(golden):
    data, expected = golden("mdata", "TC-03")
    assert expected["raises"] == GapError.__name__
    with pytest.raises(GapError, match=expected["match"]):
        align_calendar(_rows(data), max_gap=data["max_gap"])


@pytest.mark.intent
def test_tc03_gap_within_a_larger_limit_is_filled(golden):
    data, _ = golden("mdata", "TC-03")
    prices = align_calendar(_rows(data), max_gap=6)
    a_close = next(c for d, t, c in data["rows"] if t == "A")
    b_first = next(c for d, t, c in data["rows"] if t == "B")
    assert prices.tickers == ("A", "B")
    assert len(prices.dates) == len({d for d, _, _ in data["rows"]})
    assert prices.closes["A"][0] == a_close
    assert prices.closes["B"][1:7] == (b_first,) * 6
